# Independent synthetic PHASE39 PDFs

ReportLab generates these PDFs with an embedded subset of Google Fonts Noto Sans KR (SIL OFL, see OFL.txt). No customer PDF or business identifier is included. This is a different PDF construction method and layout from unicodePdf/shipping34; changing commodity strings within this generator is **not** counted as another independent layout.

The portrait identity form, bilingual declaration item table and landscape Manifest cargo table differ structurally. Manifest multi-item rows are reversed deliberately. Source faults alter printed PDF values, including the relevant totals. `cases.json` is evaluation truth, never an OpenAI prompt. `manifest.json` pins generated bytes. The holdout scenario is for later paid evaluation; its truth must not be sent as extraction guidance.

Regeneration requires Python ReportLab/fontTools and an official Noto Sans KR font, outside the repository. Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanskr . Instantiate weight400 if using the variable TTF, then `python3 tests/fixtures/phase39/generate.py --font=<static.ttf>`. CI reads the prebuilt PDFs with Node/PDF.js; Python and a font download are not CI prerequisites.
